flags.why: The word denotes a newspaper or magazine section of miscellaneous short items, not an opinion piece ([source](https://nguyenduyxuan.net/kho-tri-thuc/chu-nghia-tren-bao-chi-xua-12069.html)).
flags.fix: a newspaper or magazine column of miscellaneous short items

flags.why: The older emotional sense means being secretly pleased or excited, not feeling uneasy ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tấp_tểnh)).
flags.fix: to be secretly pleased; to feel inwardly excited

flags.why: The example portrays anxious restlessness rather than the older sense of inward pleasure ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/tấp_tểnh)).
flags.fix: Nghe tin sắp được đi hội, cô tấp tểnh mừng thầm. = Hearing that she would soon get to attend the festival, she was secretly delighted.
